name: paper_mill_benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to detect or classify manuscripts produced by paper mills or otherwise suspicious/low-quality academic submissions. It measures a model's ability to distinguish legitimate scholarly writing from fabricated or mass-produced papers using textual signals and metadata. The dataset supports development of automated screening tools for academic integrity.
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face intended for research on academic integrity and fraud detection with modest community usage so far.
